data.name: Mahmooda
data.gender_notes: Mahmooda is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mahmuud', meaning 'beloved' or 'praiseworthy'. This name is mentioned in the Quran for the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) companion, Mahmood ibn Labid. The name Mahmooda carries the meaning “Beloved, Praiseworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahmooda usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, praiseworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies love, devotion, and praiseworthiness in Islam.
data.etymology: Mahmooda belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved, Praiseworthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahmooda total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
